Name: Abe Tweaks
Author: Abezinnn
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
A collection of quality-of-life tweaks and custom additions made by my lazy brain to make Stardew Valley a bit easier and less grindy. Perfect for players who want to save some time and resources, and just chill more the game.

[color=#ff0000][b]I'm bad at spriting and the actual/incoming sprites may change.[/b][/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[left][list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Battery Machine:[/b] A brand new custom machine that produces Battery Packs. You can craft it yourself (unlocks at Mining Level 5) or buy it directly from Robin's shop. Feed it 10 Coals or 5 Copper Bars, and it will produce a Battery Pack in 10 in-game hours.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#d4d4d8]Economic Furnaces:[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] Tweaked the vanilla furnace to be much more resource-friendly. You now only need [/color][b][color=#d4d4d8]2 ores[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] (instead of 5) to smelt Copper, Iron, Gold, Iridium, and Radioactive bars![/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#d4d4d8]New features can randomly pop into my head, and you can suggest them too. I'll analyze the ideas to see [b]if they're not too cheating[/b].[/color]
[/left]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]ConcernedApe, obviously, for the great game.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Pathoschild for creating SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/color][/*]
[/list]
